name: Suncrest Energy Systems
description: Suncrest Energy Systems is an Ahmedabad-based manufacturer of string and central solar inverters, battery energy storage systems (BESS), EV-charging-ready hybrid inverters and the SunSight energy-management SaaS, serving C&I businesses, utilities, IPPs, EPC contractors and data centres across India and emerging markets.

profile.summary: Suncrest Energy Systems designs and manufactures power-conversion and storage equipment for the energy transition. Its portfolio spans 110–350 kW string inverters, 3.4 MW central inverter skids, containerised lithium-iron-phosphate BESS from 1 MWh to 5 MWh per block, EV-charging-ready hybrid inverters for commercial sites, and SunSight, a cloud platform for monitoring, forecasting and energy optimisation. Suncrest sells directly to IPPs, utilities and large C&I owners, and through a network of certified EPC partners, backed by a 9 GW installed base and 40 service hubs.
valueProps: Single-vendor solar + storage + monitoring stack that cuts integration risk and interface disputes
Made-in-India inverters and PCS that qualify for domestic-content requirements in public tenders
Up to 99% availability guarantees backed by 48-hour field replacement from 40 service hubs
SunSight SaaS turns plant data into forecasting, peak-shaving and carbon reporting for Scope 2 disclosures
Hybrid inverters ready for EV charging and battery add-ons, protecting C&I customers from stranded assets
differentiators: Grid-forming firmware certified to Indian grid code and Gulf and South African connection standards
In-house BESS integration with LFP cells rated for 6,000+ cycles and a 10-year capacity warranty
Dust- and heat-hardened IP66 enclosures proven in Rajasthan and Gulf desert sites
Open APIs and SCADA connectors for utility and data-centre building management systems
Dedicated EPC partner programme with design support, bid pricing and co-branded warranties

policies.title: Product Warranty
policies.body: StringMax and HybriCharge inverters carry a standard 5-year warranty extendable to 15 years; CentraSkid stations carry 5 years extendable to 20. VaultBESS systems are warranted for 10 years or 6,000 full cycles, whichever comes first, with a guaranteed 70% end-of-warranty capacity. Warranty claims are handled through SunSight tickets with a 48-hour field response in India and 5 business days internationally.

policies.title: Grid-Compliance Certifications
policies.body: All Suncrest inverters and PCS are tested to IEC 62109, IEC 61727 and IEC 62116, and comply with the Indian central grid-connectivity regulations including low- and high-voltage ride-through. Export variants hold certification for Gulf utility connection codes and South African grid code for renewable plants. VaultBESS containers are tested to UL 9540A thermal-runaway propagation standards. Test reports are available to customers and lenders on request.

policies.title: EPC Partner Discount Policy
policies.body: Certified EPC partners receive a base discount of 6% off list on inverters and 4% on VaultBESS. Silver partners (above 50 MW per year) receive an additional 3%; Gold partners (above 200 MW per year) an additional 5% plus bid-support pricing locked for 90 days. Discounts beyond 14% in total require Regional Sales Director approval. Partner pricing must not be quoted directly to end customers.

customSignals.name: Commercial EV Charging Depot Rollout
customSignals.description: A fleet operator, logistics company or commercial landlord rolls out an EV charging depot or hub that needs hybrid inverters, solar canopies and storage to manage grid demand.
customSignals.matchInstructions: Match when a named organisation announces an EV charging depot, charging hub or fleet electrification programme with a stated number of chargers, vehicles, power demand or investment, especially where solar or storage is mentioned. Do NOT match EV sales figures, vehicle launches, or consumer charging-app partnerships.

customSignals.name: Battery Storage Tender
customSignals.description: A utility, DISCOM or IPP issues or wins a battery energy storage tender, or adds BESS to an existing plant — a direct opportunity for Suncrest BESS containers and PCS.
customSignals.matchInstructions: Match when an event reports a battery energy storage (BESS) tender, award, or procurement with MWh capacity, or a solar/wind plant adding storage for peak shaving or frequency regulation. Do NOT match EV battery cell manufacturing, lithium mining, or pumped-hydro-only storage.
